evidence.decision: Classifies consequence, visibility and update cadence; calibration is necessary only for the feature needing it.
evidence.artifact: Requires role/error/feedback/calibration contract and consequence-based evaluation plan.
evidence.transformation: Music opening no longer means approval; unsupported confidence gives way to reasons and specific persistent feedback.
evidence.verification: Checks correction persistence, unnecessary calibration, shared-context disclosure and unvalidated confidence; broad optional-feature failure wording was corrected.
evidence.applicability: Separates validated accuracy/calibration from model names and static design from representative evaluation.
evidence.handoffs: Generative AI handles created content; Privacy handles behavioral data flow.
evidence.distinctiveness: Ambiguous implicit signals, cadence, confidence calibration and class-level error tradeoffs are ML-specific.
